question: Do LS-bracket / harmonic-division omega-magnitude grid strategies cover truth-|omega| within +-5% on >=80/100 post-fix m048 seeds?
hypothesis: Treating Lomb-Scargle as a bracket / multi-hypothesis grid (not a point estimate) covers truth-|omega| within 5% on >=80/100 seeds.

artefacts.caption: Per-strategy omega-mag coverage within 5% of truth, 100 seeds

narrative_md: Cohort replication of m138's LS-bracket omega-mag coverage under correct truth on 100 post-fix m048 seeds (pure spectral on cached mag_hifi, 7.5 s). Bracket clears the pre-registered 80/100 bar at 98/100 within 5% (median offset 1.25%, p90 2.26%); harm-div 97/100; LS-top1 catastrophic at 19/100, confirming the point-estimator class stays dead. Collapses the omega-mag axis to ~5 cells covering 98% of cohort. Coverage metric compares grids to truth-|omega| (reads truth as input).
